name: ARMOR-SERVER
role: Central event coordinator and web API
build: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
notes: Provides a secured development API, WebSocket state relay and deterministic event reducer. Native HTTPS/WSS (TLS_CERT_PATH/TLS_KEY_PATH, same convention as HYDRA-UMC-SERVER's own) is real and tested against a real self-signed certificate, but has never been run with a real publicly-trusted certificate on real hardware. Broker, camera and field-device adapters remain separately validated deployment work.
